name: Akiha Rumiho
source: Faris Nyannyan works at the maid cafe "Mayqueen Nyannyan", the same maid cafe that Shiina works at, and is the most popular waitress there. Her real name is Akiha Rumiho, whose family owns Akihabara, her being the one suggested it become the city of moe and anime. She tends to add "nyan" to her sentences.
